card.name: Run-together words in web addresses
card.fires_on: Pieces inside web addresses after www where several words are joined with no spaces, and also words in text that has had its spaces stripped out. It responds at the point where the next joined word begins.

modes.label: Web address words
modes.description: Pieces of a domain name made of several joined words, after www.

modes.label: Spaceless text
modes.description: Words inside label text that has lost its spaces.

modes.label: Drug name before may
modes.description: The word may after a drug name at the start of a risk sentence.
modes.example: Fingolimod<<may>> cause fetal harm when administered to a pregnant

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with short joined-up word pieces, as in a domain name without spaces, and away from spacing characters and meta- or bio- words.
card.plain: It fires on the middle of web addresses and other text where words are run together with no spaces.
